lines.japanese: 五時間目は体育だった。
lines.english: Fifth period was phys ed.

lines.japanese: バスケットボールの紅白試合で、針生さんは珍しく精力的に動きまわり、敵味方双方からの感嘆や喝采を集めていた。
lines.english: During a class basketball game, Hariu ran around with unusual energy, drawing admiration and cheers from both teams.

lines.japanese: 何人かの男子は勇気を出して話しかけていたけれど、やっぱり藤野君は敬語が取れなかったみたいだ。
lines.english: A few of the boys worked up the courage to speak to him, but Fujino apparently still couldn't stop using formal language.

lines.japanese: そして教室への帰り道。僕は針生さんと並んで歩いていた。
lines.english: Afterward, on the way back to class, I walked beside Hariu.

lines.japanese: 「そうだ、そういえば新しいゲーム雑誌見ました？　『星空ガガーリン』の続編にあたるタイトルが発表されてましたよ」
lines.english: “Oh, that reminds me. Did you see the new game magazine? They announced the follow-up to *Starry-Sky Gagarin*.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、ギャルゲーかあ。そんな時代もあったなァ」
lines.english: “Oh, romance games. I remember that phase of my life.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「アレはもう極めた。いまは世界遺産だろ」
lines.english: “I've mastered those already. World Heritage Sites are where it's at now.”

lines.japanese: 意外だった。昨日は妹萌えについて、あんなに語りあったのに。
lines.english: That was unexpected. Only yesterday we had talked so passionately about the appeal of little-sister characters.

lines.japanese: 僕はふとあの日のことを思いだした。
lines.english: I found myself remembering that day.

lines.japanese: 「羽田。妹萌えという概念について、先達であるおまえの教えを乞いたい」
lines.english: “Haneda. As my predecessor in the field, I ask you to teach me about the appeal of little-sister characters.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、どうしたんですか突然」
lines.english: “What? Why ask me that all of a sudden?”

lines.japanese: 「鳳凰寺カケルがその道のスペシャリストだと聞いてなァ。べつにあんな男と張りあう気はねえけど、やつが極めているものを俺がまったく知らないというのも具合が悪い」
lines.english: “I heard Kakeru Hououji's a specialist in the field. Not that I've got any interest in competing with a man like him, but it doesn't sit right with me to know absolutely nothing about something he's mastered.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど……でも正直、鳳君の妹萌えはかなりのレベルですよ。生半可な覚悟じゃ太刀打ちできないと思います」
lines.english: “I see... But to be honest, Ohtori’s devotion to little-sister characters is on an extremely high level. I don’t think you can challenge him without serious resolve.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、べつにあんな男と張りあう気はねえけど、どんな修行にも音はあげないつもりだ。頼む、教えてくれ」
lines.english: “Yeah. Not that I've got any interest in competing with a man like him, but no training regimen will make me cry uncle. Please. Teach me.”

lines.japanese: 「分かりました。おれのやり方は少々手荒いですよ。まずは駅前のソフトショップへ行って『可愛すぎて妹っちゃう』を買ってきてください。通常版は駄目です、ドラマＣＤが付いていません」
lines.english: “All right. My methods are somewhat harsh. First, go to the software store by the station and buy *She's So Cute, I'm Going Full Little Sister*. The standard edition is no good. It doesn't come with the drama CD.”

lines.japanese: 「『可愛すぎて妹っちゃう』だな……ふン、面白い。潤ってみせるぜ……」
lines.english: “*She's So Cute, I'm Going Full Little Sister*... Hmph. Interesting. I'll get myself good and moist...”

lines.japanese: ──なんて言ってたのに。もう潤ってしまったのだろうか。
lines.english: —or so he had said. Had he already gotten moist enough?

lines.japanese: 「あァ、昨夜午前４時、俺は真理に辿りついてしまった」
lines.english: “At four o'clock this morning, I arrived at the truth.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、どういうことですか」
lines.english: “What does that mean?”

lines.japanese: 「よくよく調べてみると鳳凰寺カケルは別ジャンルだった」
lines.english: “When I investigated more carefully, I discovered that Kakeru Hououji belonged to a different genre.”

lines.japanese: 「べ、別ジャンル……？　え、でも彼の妹萌えは、おれでも知ってるぐらい有名ですよ。そんな──」
lines.english: “A-a different genre...? But his devotion to little-sister characters is famous enough that even I know about it. Surely—”

lines.japanese: 「さすがはマイスター。気付いたか」
lines.english: “As expected of the master. You've realized.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、まさか……まさか彼は禁断の……」
lines.english: “D-don't tell me... Don't tell me his love is the forbidden kind...”

lines.japanese: 「イグザクトリィ。そのまさかさ。やつは──」
lines.english: “Exactly. The very thing you're thinking. He is—”

lines.japanese: 「リアル妹萌えだった」
lines.english: “—into his real little sister.”

lines.japanese: 「そして俺には妹がいない。べつにあんな男と張りあう気はねえが、つまり、まァ、いくら自分を高めても永劫やつと同じリングには立てないってことだ」
lines.english: “And I haven't got a sister. Not that I've got any interest in competing with a man like him, but no matter how far I elevate myself, I'll never be able to enter the same ring.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなとき、雑音を浴びたくて失意のうちに点けたクイズバラエティから、俺は地球の広大さと歴史の悠久さを知った」
lines.english: “Then, crushed by despair and wanting a little noise, I switched on a TV quiz show. It taught me the vastness of the Earth and the boundless sweep of history.”

lines.japanese: 「え、針生さん、意外と俗なテレビに影響されるんですね」
lines.english: “You're surprisingly susceptible to trashy television, Hariu.”

lines.japanese: 「学問に貴賤はないでしょう。肝要なのは誰から学ぶかじゃない、自分の中の何を起こすかだ。俺に言わせりゃあ、ハーバードの一流講師もスーパーふとし君も大差はねえよ。所詮は起爆剤だからなァ」
lines.english: “There's no rank in learning. What matters isn't who teaches you. It's what they awaken inside you. As far as I'm concerned, there's not much difference between a first-rate Harvard lecturer and Super Futoshi. They're only detonators.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、そうか。たしか前回、ゲストで蛎崎うにが出てたから」
lines.english: “Oh, right. I think Uni Kakizaki was the guest on the last episode.”

lines.japanese: 「理由は関係ない、所詮は起爆剤だ」
lines.english: “My reason is irrelevant. She was only a detonator.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、しかも蛎崎うに、世界遺産が好きだって言ってたような……」
lines.english: “And now that I think about it, Uni Kakizaki said she loved World Heritage Sites...”

lines.japanese: 「起爆剤だ。爆ぜていきなよ、エクスプローシヴ・ボーイ」
lines.english: “A detonator. Go blow yourself wide open, Explosive Boy.”

lines.japanese: そのあとは、針生さんの新しい趣味についてたっぷり聞かせてもらった。
lines.english: After that, Hariu told me all about his new hobby.

lines.japanese: 世界遺産の話は興味深くてそれなりに楽しめたけれど、もう『星空ガガーリン』や『可愛すぎて妹っちゃう』『いもももと』を語りあうことが出来ないのはとても残念だった。
lines.english: The World Heritage stories were interesting enough, and I enjoyed them in their way. Still, I was very disappointed that we could no longer discuss *Starry-Sky Gagarin*, *She's So Cute, I'm Going Full Little Sister*, or *Imomomoto*.

lines.japanese: 放課後。
lines.english: After school.

lines.japanese: 僕らは藤野君に付きしたがって、本日の職場である宮川書店を訪れた。
lines.english: We followed Fujino to Miyagawa Bookstore, where we would be working today.

lines.japanese: まだこんな時間だけど、本日こちらは店内一斉配置換えということで、終日店を開けないとのことだった。
lines.english: It was still early, but the store was closed all day so that everything inside could be rearranged at once.

lines.japanese: 「ハハッ、なんか店長が喜んでんの、四人も来てくれたから今日中に終わるって。羽田ー、つうか羽田班のお陰だわ、ほんとアリガト」
lines.english: “Haha! The manager's thrilled. Says with four of you, we'll finish today. Haneda—or really, the whole Haneda team—you saved me. Seriously, thanks.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ悪いけど、あとは店のスタッフに聞きながらやってよ。えっと……いつも二人ずつ、組でやってるから、とりあえず２×２に分かれてもらっといた方がいいかも」
lines.english: “Sorry to dump the rest on you, but ask the store staff what to do. Um... They always work in pairs, so maybe split into two teams of two for now.”

lines.japanese: 「分かった、ありがとう。もう大丈夫だよ」
lines.english: “Got it. Thanks. We'll be fine from here.”

lines.japanese: じゃあ、と言いのこして、藤野君はもうひとつのバイトへ向かった。表向きは家庭の用事ということになっていたけど。
lines.english: With a quick goodbye, Fujino headed to his other job. Officially, he had family business to take care of.

lines.japanese: 「さて」
lines.english: “All right.”

lines.japanese: 残された僕らは作戦を練る。
lines.english: Those of us left behind drew up our plan.

lines.japanese: 「まず二人組だって。どう分ける？」
lines.english: “First, he said pairs. How should we split up?”

lines.japanese: 「ジャンケンでもする？」
lines.english: “Want to play rock-paper-scissors?”

lines.japanese: 「やめときなよ。人生は長いんだ、若いうちから運の無駄遣いをすることはないでしょう」
lines.english: “Don't. You've got a long life ahead of you. No sense wasting your luck while you're young.”

lines.japanese: 「うわぁ……針生先輩、映画んときの負け、まだ根に持ってるんだ」
lines.english: “Wow... Kuroudo, you’re still bitter about losing at the movies?”

lines.japanese: 「運だめしが嫌なら仕方ないね。班長の恣意で決めてもらおうか」
lines.english: “If you don't want to leave it to chance, I suppose we'll let the team leader decide according to his whims.”
“...What, me?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。羽田君が組みたいパートナーをひとり選べば、その時点で選ばれなかった二人のペアも確定するでしょ」
lines.english: “Yes. Once you choose the partner you want, the two people you didn't choose automatically become the other pair.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　選ばれなかったとか、そんな言い方しないでよ、決めにくくなっちゃう……ねえ？」
lines.english: “What? Don't say ‘the people you didn't choose.’ Now you've made it hard to decide... right?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、そんな上目遣いで、ねえ言われても」
lines.english: “Don't look up at me like that and say ‘right?’”

lines.japanese: 「やめろ明日香、これ以上羽田を追いつめるな」
lines.english: “Stop, Asuka. Don't corner Haneda any further.”

lines.japanese: 「私は何もしてないっ」
lines.english: “I haven't done anything!”

lines.japanese: 「どうする、羽田君。やっぱり渡来さんと組む？」
lines.english: “What will you do, Haneda? Would you rather pair up with Watarai after all?”
